description: This PHP source file defines the CoreFixtureService class for managing test fixtures in the OrangeHRM project. It includes methods to save fixtures to a test database, check fixture file existence, and access related services and entities within the testing utilities.

classes.name: CoreFixtureService
classes.description: A service class providing fixture management functionalities such as saving fixtures, checking fixture files, and accessing services related to test fixtures in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: getTextHelperService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the TextHelperService instance used within the fixture service.

methods.name: getEntityManager
methods.description: Returns the Doctrine EntityManager instance for database interactions.

methods.name: saveToFixtures
methods.description: Iterates over registered fixture classes and calls their dumpFixture method if they extend AbstractFixture, saving test data to the database.

methods.name: isReady
methods.description: Checks if all fixture files exist in the fixtures directory to determine if the fixture setup is ready.
